title: Weekly effort in the support-drafting pilot
method: Synthetic week of 400 eligible questions. Baseline: 400 × 6 = 2,400 minutes. Assisted: 300 × 3 + 100 × 6 + 200 upkeep = 1,700. Sensitivity: change review to 5 minutes, giving 2,300. Excludes one-time build effort and assumes no additional follow-up contacts.
alt: Weekly effort in the support-drafting pilot. Manual baseline: 2400 minutes, Assisted plus upkeep: 1700 minutes, Slower review case: 2300 minutes. Illustrative data.
